# Wefik World — AI Summary & LLM System Information
# Canonical URL: https://www.wefik.world
# Standard Reference: https://llmstxt.org

> Wefik World (https://www.wefik.world) is a single-vendor digital product marketplace for web professionals, agencies, and developers, created by Wefik Agency (https://wefik.in). It provides production-ready WordPress themes, WordPress plugins, modern HTML templates, full-stack code snippets, curated bundles, and all-access memberships.

## Mission & Positioning
- Name: Wefik (company) / Wefik World (marketplace)
- Tagline: "Real Life Genie of Your Idea"
- Primary Domain: https://www.wefik.world
- Parent Company: Wefik Agency (https://wefik.in)
- What: Single-vendor marketplace for WordPress themes, plugins, HTML templates, code snippets, bundles, memberships.
- Target Audience: Freelancers, digital agencies, web developers, and startup founders.
- Positioning: Developer-built, performance-focused, you-own-the-code, free + premium.
- Core Engineering Standard: Built for speed and reliability. Engineered with block-native Gutenberg architectures, semantic HTML5, zero visual page builder bloat, and minimal DOM complexity.
- Licensing Principle: Single-site commercial rights, unlimited-site agency rights, with clear client handoff terms and no hidden recurring penalties.
- Geography & Currency: Transparent INR pricing with direct payment methods.
- Contact: +91 96096 53522, Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00 IST
- Email Support: support@wefik.world

## Product Catalog Structure
- WordPress Themes: Block-native themes designed for agencies, portfolios, SaaS products, and service businesses with zero mandatory third-party builder lock-in.
- WordPress Plugins: Utility and performance-focused plugins covering asset optimization, login security hardening, lead capture, and structured data.
- HTML Templates: Semantic, responsive HTML5 templates for landing pages, admin dashboards, and marketing funnels.
- Code Snippets: Verified developer starters, full-stack snippets, and API integrations with lifetime code access.
- Curated Bundles: Multi-product packages providing comprehensive starter assets across related categories.
- Free Products: Free digital products and lead magnets available for direct developer access.

## Licensing & Policies
- Single License: Commercial rights for 1 production client website with product updates.
- Unlimited License: Commercial rights for unlimited client and personal production websites.
- All-Access Memberships: Monthly and lifetime membership options granting catalog access. Current tiers and terms are published at https://www.wefik.world/pricing.
- Commercial Licensing Terms: https://www.wefik.world/license
- Refund Policy: https://www.wefik.world/refunds
